About Ambika Enterprises

Ambika Enterprises is owned and run by Ambika S and Siddappaji. We help customers in Kumaraswamy Layout find natural products, personal care and wellness essentials in one convenient place.

We have been serving our neighbourhood for one year, and we are an authorised retailer of Keramruth and Swadeshi Disha products. Visit us, call us or message us on WhatsApp and we will help you find what suits you.
